scope: TechDraw BOM row sorting; addon only, backend and schema unchanged

checks: Native Drawing BOM editor defaults to ascending natural item numbers
Numeric descending preview keeps custom text attached to its component
Embedded format 4 retains sort policy, original report/token, language provenance and notes
Previous addon safely rejects editing format 4 instead of discarding sorting
Explicit item-number sort updates the native SVG while keeping its original notes
Opening a legacy localized table preserves its original layout, row order and embedded bytes
Native FCStd save/reopen/recompute retains sorted SVG and frozen evidence without refetching
Real TechDraw exports the reopened frozen table to PDF
Original documents, unsaved edits, frozen tables, labels, active document and authenticated session are preserved
native.scope: Disposable native documents only; no production CAD or server mutations

sorting.text: Deterministic natural comparison ignoring case and accents
sorting.numeric: Decimal comparison; missing values last in both directions
sorting.indented: Sort siblings and retain complete subtrees
sorting.legacy_layout_default: Stored BOM order until explicitly changed

preservation: Original source report, evidence token, revision pins, BOM positions and quantities are unchanged by sorting.
Custom text remains keyed to occurrence/revision identities rather than visual row indices.
Existing tables and PDFs are never updated merely by reopening, recomputing or upgrading.
Older addons safely reject updates to unsupported format 4 while embedded native SVG remains visible.
No production engineering data, CAD files or drawing tables were changed by acceptance.
publication: Local review; not committed or pushed
